audit_items.proof_trace: The property describes a snapshot array model (len(snapshots) ±1), but Nethermind uses a change-log-based architecture with transaction boundary markers in _transactionChangesSnapshots stack. While Commit/Reset clear the entire stack (not decrement by 1), this is intentional: they finalize or abort all pending changes in the current block context. The semantic invariant (begin_tx balanced by commit/rollback) holds at the transaction processor level through the ExecutionOptions flow, even though the implementation doesn't match the spec's literal data structure.
